notes: Not standard RNA-seq: 4 samples are in vitro transcripts, the in vivo sample is PCR amplicons of one plasmid transcript (rpoBC fragment from lambda PR on pPR9) for error-rate measurement; all assay_class other. In vivo sample: thermal induction 2 h at 42 C labelled heat/short; OD 2.3 -> no phase; overexpression of native rpoBC fragment from plasmid.

assay_class.q: The 5’ fragment of the 5.7 kb RNA transcripts was reverse transcribed to make the cDNA. The cDNA was subjected to PCR reactions that generated six 200 bp segments.

base_medium.q: Cells were cultured in LB medium containing ampicillin at 28˚C

medium_class.q: Cells were cultured in LB medium containing ampicillin at 28˚C

amino_acids_supplied.q: Cells were cultured in LB medium containing ampicillin at 28˚C

growth_temperature.q: incubated for 2 hr at 28˚C (OD600 reached 0.35) and then for 2 hr at 42˚C (OD600 reached 2.3) to induce the PR promoter

treatment.q: incubated for 2 hr at 28˚C (OD600 reached 0.35) and then for 2 hr at 42˚C (OD600 reached 2.3) to induce the PR promoter

exposure.q: incubated for 2 hr at 28˚C (OD600 reached 0.35) and then for 2 hr at 42˚C (OD600 reached 2.3) to induce the PR promoter
